title: Is Elon Musk Exploring Collaboration with TSMC on Terafab?
gist: Forum post summarizing the status of Elon Musk's Terafab chip-fab project partners: Intel has formally joined (April 7, 2026) and Musk said Terafab would use Intel 14A; Musk acknowledged only exploratory talks with TSMC, which per Tim Culpan could own and run a Texas facility with Terafab as anchor customer; Samsung outreach is reported but unconfirmed.

insights.claim: On October 3 Elon Musk acknowledged exploratory talks with TSMC about Terafab, saying 'Just discussions, but something may come of it'; no agreement has been announced.
insights.speaker: SemiWiki
insights.so_what: A TSMC tie-up would materially de-risk Terafab and expand TSMC's US footprint, but it is not yet a base case.
insights.quote: Just discussions, but something may come of it.
insights.locator: Is Elon Musk Exploring Collaboration with TSMC

insights.claim: According to Tim Culpan's reporting, TSMC could help operate Terafab's planned Texas chip factories, potentially owning and running a facility with Terafab as an anchor customer.
insights.speaker: SemiWiki
insights.so_what: An anchor-customer model would shift capex and execution risk onto TSMC while giving Musk's companies dedicated capacity.
insights.quote: potentially owning and running a facility with Terafab as an anchor customer

insights.claim: Intel announced on April 7, 2026 that it joined Terafab with Musk's companies, contributing chip design, manufacturing and packaging expertise, and Musk later said Terafab would use Intel's next-generation 14A process.
insights.speaker: SemiWiki
insights.so_what: Terafab is a potential marquee external customer validating Intel 14A and its foundry ambitions.
insights.quote: Musk subsequently said Terafab would use Intel’s next-generation 14A manufacturing process.

insights.claim: The author cautions that Intel's announced collaboration does not mean Terafab's factories or production technology are ready.
insights.speaker: SemiWiki
insights.so_what: Execution and timing risk remain high for both Terafab and Intel 14A.
insights.quote: though it doesn’t mean the factories or production technology are ready

insights.claim: Bloomberg reported in April 2026 that Musk's Terafab team approached Samsung for support, but Reuters could not independently verify it and the author found no public announcement that Samsung formally joined.
insights.speaker: SemiWiki
insights.so_what: Musk appears to be courting all three leading-edge foundries, suggesting Terafab seeks multi-sourced capacity or leverage.
